verdict.rationale: Asking whether a public agency's website and online filing system let users opt out of analytics or usage tracking is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, cookies, analytics, or tracking opt-out. The items cover filing procedures, fees, and agent-access probes, none of which bear on the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
